title: Introduction to Probability and Venn Diagrams
description: Introduce probability through finite sample spaces, events, complements, and Venn-diagram regions.

title: Axioms of Probability and Counting Methods
description: Apply the probability axioms and systematic counting methods to finite outcome spaces.

title: Conditional Probability, Independence, and Bayes' Formula
description: Restrict the sample space, test independence, and update probabilities with Bayes' formula.

title: Random Variables, PMFs, CDFs, Expectation, and Variance
description: Represent discrete random variables and compute probabilities, expectation, and variance.

title: Bernoulli, Binomial, Geometric, Poisson, and Other Discrete Random Variables
description: Work with the named discrete probability models introduced together in the course schedule.

title: Normal Distribution, Normal Approximation, and Functions of a Random Variable
description: Use normal models and normal approximations, then study distributions of transformed random variables.
